services.text: Services Pulse combines weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At 17.8 in August 2026, it is above its five-year norm, rising from 15.6 a month earlier and -18.1 three months earlier. ABS mining capex expectations is the largest positive contributor (+10.8), while NSW coal export value is the largest negative contributor (-4.9).

products.text: Products Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its listed inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At 27.6 on 30 September 2026, it is above its five-year norm; it has eased from 29.4 a month earlier but remains above 25.7 three months ago and 11.9 six months ago. US new orders for iron and steel mills is the biggest positive contributor (+25.0), while inverted AUD/USD is the biggest negative (-15.2); AISI capacity utilisation and discontinued CAT retail-sales data are excluded.

margin.text: Margin Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of fitter/welder vacancy tightness and AUD/USD against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At -21.9 in September 2026, it is below its five-year norm and has weakened from -7.9 three months earlier and 11.3 a year earlier. AUD/USD is the largest negative contributor (-35.5), while fitter/welder vacancy tightness is the largest positive contributor (+13.6); tungsten policy flags are excluded pending sufficient history.

technology.text: The pipeline holds 2 leads, 3 agreements and 2 commissioned cells, with $2.4 million in stated contracted value and no stated recognised value.
